Gate-consuming false proof in packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:227-240,1140-1154. In --proof-scenarios mode the runner executes only the fixed canonical scenario IDs, then adaptCanonicalScenarioRecordsToActiveTopology clones a canonical record by kind (index modulo the available templates) and rewrites only assertion ID, kind, and sourceRef. The --live-proof path consumes those projected records at lines 276-294; pre-review-live-proof.ts:64-97 validates only expected ID/kind/sourceRef and the verifier at pre-review-check.ts:174-204 validates shape, aggregate digest, mutation uniqueness, outcome equality, and transcript event ordering. It does not bind the active assertion to the operation, mutation target, or distinct transcript events that were actually executed. B-5a88 has 7 positive, 14 mutation, and 21 transcript assertions, so its 21 transcript records can all be cloned from the one canonical transcript record and still pass exact-ID/source/order checks. This allows an unexecuted or semantically mismatched active topology to produce accepted pre-review evidence; each active assertion must instead be executed and emitted with assertion-specific evidence, or the verifier must prove a canonical case-to-topology semantic binding before admission.

The verifier-owned map binds CHK-006:happy:0, whose active claim is sibling package metadata/lockfile/dependency-graph consistency, to A-POS-1's role-guidance/mirror operation; it binds CHK-007:happy:0, whose active claim is bin/residue behavior, to A-POS-2's frozen cohort-receipt operation. preReviewCaseSemanticMatches only compares the hardcoded target/mutationKind/operation and never derives or validates that tuple from the referenced verificationIntent; packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:198-212 consumes it as sufficient. A current signed proof can therefore satisfy this map while never executing the CHK-006/CHK-007 claims, preserving F-337's gate-consuming false-proof class. Bind each sourceRef to its actual intent semantic operation or execute each active assertion, and reject unrelated mappings.
